## Classification Rules

- `ACTIVE_LEAK`: only for explicit true-permission leakage inside V4 controlled observe active scope.
- `GUARD_DENYLIST`: explicit denylist/forbidden guard context.
- `NEGATIVE_TEST`: negative-test harness context.
- `HISTORICAL_DOC`: legacy/non-active scope references.
- `CLOSURE_FALSE_FIELD`: closure/status fields documenting false guards.
- `CHECKER_EXPECTED_FALSE`: checker fail-closed validation or blocker strings.
- `FALSE_POSITIVE`: non-active textual hit requiring no behavior change.
